title: `TIMESTAMPTZ + INTERVAL` follows the session time zone
verdict: the same instant plus a day is 10:00 or 11:00 UTC across a DST change, by `TimeZone`
description: Adding `INTERVAL 1 DAY` to `TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-03-30 12:00:00+01'` gives 2024-03-31 12:00 CEST (10:00 UTC) under `TimeZone = 'Europe/Berlin'` and 2024-03-31 11:00 UTC under `TimeZone = 'UTC'`: calendar arithmetic on an instant depends on a zone the plan does not state.
reference: `Kind.timeTz` is refused: the reference's calendar arithmetic on instants would need a time zone the plan does not carry.

provenance.checked_by: #1166 restatement probe (session youthful-margulis), duckdb 2.0.0, macOS arm64

evidence.sql: set TimeZone='Europe/Berlin'; select TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-03-30 12:00:00+01' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
set TimeZone='UTC'; select TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-03-30 12:00:00+01' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
